title: Groundwater BI
question: Can the same public groundwater marts support consistent metrics and authenticated, watershed-scoped embedded analytics?
one_liner: dbt and DuckDB marts, offline LookML validation, censoring-safe default metrics and a FastAPI host that authenticates demo identities before minting tenant-scoped embed URLs.
aim: Keep metrics and authorization definitions reviewable in git and exercise the boundaries between a warehouse, a semantic layer and an embedded host application.
scope: Committed public groundwater snapshot, dbt marts and tests, parsed LookML schema, synthetic consumer metric contracts, bearer authentication, signed host sessions and tenant authorization. Hex remains a planned app with tested SQL and setup notes.
conclusion: The runnable warehouse and host demonstrate censoring-preserving rows, detected-subset concentration metrics and server-side tenant entitlements. Choosing another tenant slug does not grant access. Live Looker, a published Hex app and an exercised Metabase dashboard are not claimed.
finding: Default concentration measures use detected_value, which excludes non-detects and detected-but-not-quantified results. They are explicitly labelled detected subset and cannot substitute for a censoring-aware population median. True detections remain included when no reporting limit is supplied.

The host resolves authenticated identity and permitted tenants from a server-side demo registry. Anonymous requests, cross-tenant selections and tampered or expired host sessions are denied. Registry revocation prevents new embed tokens; already-issued tokens remain usable until expiry.
LookML is validated offline against the built schema. The future Hex app has a runnable SQL contract and setup notes; no published link, exported notebook or account integration is claimed.

traps.how: Raw reported values remain audit fields; default aggregates use measured detections and display their selected-subset scope.
Comparable constituent definitions include family, characteristic, fraction and unit; consumer queries group by those definitions.
Fact keys and dimension relationships are validated by dbt; semantic joins are checked offline against available fields.

not_claimed: No live Looker validation, published Hex app or exercised Metabase dashboard.
The identity registry is a concrete demo, not a production identity provider.
Detected-subset medians are not population medians, remediation evidence or groundwater trend estimates.
data: Cleaned public-domain USGS groundwater results from the companion Groundwater Audit snapshot
